name: OutlookScene
description: Synthetic Outlook mail/calendar/compose shell with structured chrome defaults, optional slot HTML, and Contoso demo-data scrubbing.

accountInitial.description: Single initial shown in account chrome. Derived from accountName when omitted.

currentFolder.description: Legacy mail-folder selection used with stepsHtml.

stepsHtml.description: Legacy message-list or event-card HTML inserted into the generated Outlook body.

viewBodyHtml.description: Main Outlook body HTML slot. Overrides legacy body generation.

toastTitle.description: Toast title when toastState is visible.

toastBody.description: Toast body when toastState is visible.

qualityNotes: Use OutlookScene when the story actually needs mail, calendar, search, or compose context.
Prefer structured slot HTML over screenshots so text remains deterministic.
Demo content is scrubbed toward Contoso-style names/domains for internal-safe renders.
